uart0.lcr.description: QEMU virt 16550 UART line control register. Reading LCR does not acknowledge interrupts or consume receive data. LSR is intentionally excluded because reading it can clear error indications.

word_length.description: Character length is this value plus five bits.

even_parity.description: Even parity selected when parity is enabled.

stick_parity.description: Stick parity selected when parity is enabled.

divisor_latch_access.description: DLAB: offsets zero and one select divisor latches instead of normal data and interrupt-enable registers.

uart0.scr.description: QEMU 6.2 virt 16550 UART scratch register, at offset seven with serial_mm regshift=0. In the verified QEMU v6.2.0 source, serial_ioport_write case 7 only stores s->scr = val and serial_ioport_read case 7 returns s->scr. This stored-byte policy is specific to the emulated device; it does not establish safety on unverified real hardware. Source: https://gitlab.com/qemu-project/qemu/-/raw/v6.2.0/hw/char/serial.c

uart.normal_access.description: PASS means DLAB is clear and UART offsets zero and one select normal registers. This does not establish transmit readiness or general device health. Reads LCR once, without writes or polling.
